Masked junior who defined New Japan's undercard for decades.

How Jushin Thunder Liger connects

  • Item: IWGP Junior Heavyweight Championship — Jushin Thunder Liger defined the IWGP Junior Heavyweight Championship.

What is Jushin Thunder Liger?

Jushin Thunder Liger was New Japan's long-running junior heavyweight ace, a mask-and-shooting-star figure whose IWGP Junior lineage later fighters still claim.

Key threads lead to IWGP Junior Heavyweight Championship.
